name: Franz Schubert
summary: Detail-oriented Database Administrator with over 5 years of experience managing large databases. Skilled in database design, maintenance, and optimization. Committed to ensuring data integrity and security while providing high-quality support to development teams.

description: Managed a team responsible for overseeing database architecture and performance.
Optimized SQL queries resulting in a 30% increase in application speed.
Developed backup and recovery strategies to prevent data loss.
Collaborated with software developers to design and maintain database systems.
Assisted in the management of database systems for various clients.
Performed data migrations and integrity checks.
Supported the development team in troubleshooting database issues.
Implemented security measures resulting in compliance with data protection regulations.
